name: Torn Mystical Scroll
summary: A torn scroll bears faint magic and unfamiliar runes. You bring it to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay, where he sees promise in its writing.

sections.title: A Curious Scrap
sections.body: A faint magic clings to the torn scroll, and its runes are strange to you. You sense no danger in it, though most would call the parchment useless. Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay may find a use for the scrap.

sections.title: Dudd's Work
sections.body: Dudd Fizzlescroll is eager to copy the runes into his work. He speaks of becoming a legendary engineer, then warns you to keep clear so you will not be hurt.

faq.answer: It is a scrap of parchment bearing faint magic and unfamiliar runes. You sense that it is not dangerous.
